description: A random sample (Python random.seed(1), random.sample) of 100 of the 1,811 Standard decklists of Arena Championship 13 and the two Magic Spotlight: Fracture events (Beijing, Hartford), the events behind the Magic.gg Metagame Mentor table of 2026-11-05, excluding the lists already in ../meta and ../fracture-2026-field. Every list counts once (meta_share 1.0), so the sample stands for the field by its real composition. See README.md.
